purpose: Repair posterior consumption, accept smoke, launch and supervise matched 3-arm x 2-seed training; completion of full training is not required within eight hours.

b0.data: First 24 observed frames of 512 equally spaced ORCA episodes with length >=24; 12288 real episode/frame identities, no candidate successor states.
b0.failure: Stop before changing Bayesian encoder; investigate discrepancy rather than selecting a passing cohort.

b1.cohort: First 32 saved native benchmark episodes in each of the six original scenarios; original saved seeds, original Full policy and safety settings.
b1.sigma: sqrt(diagonal filtered variance) on actual legal current-history window
b1.censoring: Do not label a shorter safe future window as a complete k-step negative.
b1.split: Episode indices divisible by four are held out, no frame-level random split.
b1.claim_boundary: AUC is predictive association, not proof of Bayesian calibration or causal navigation value; KL alone is not guaranteed to add hazard information.

repair.mean_arm: variance channels replaced by exact zeros
repair.value_head_shape: Linear(256,1), unchanged for all three arms
repair.sigma_cubature: Removed from new model, old source/checkpoints preserved.

initialization.parity_mapping: old readout weight into FIRST 64 mean columns, variance columns zero; bias and other weights copied. Diagnostic only, not trained outcomes.
initialization.training: Matched 50-epoch IL from the frozen offline corpus for new shapes/seeds. Reuse a newly accepted matching IL checkpoint, not old incompatible readout or smoke RL weights.
initialization.formal_start: Selected IL checkpoint for each arm and seed; fresh online RL, no smoke RL continuation.

smoke.pass: all complete, strict expected IL loading and dataset version/hash, GRID=80, finite saved policy/optimizer, aggregate 200 training-episode SR strictly between zero and one, no traceback

operational.pid_identity: pid plus /proc starttime, no self-matching grep

b2: Optional after priority acceptance/startup work; at most 12 frozen failed-root first-action replay tests, not a population SR upper bound.
